source_editing_policy: All5 are direct built-in imagegen outputs; originals and byte-identical full-canvas copies are retained. No masks, feathering, color/alpha cleanup, local composites or source pixel edits in the adopted path.
observations: Wave family keeps canonical identity, large head proportion, body/tail/feet coherent at400px. Direct edits have slight texture/contour differences, so pixel-identical head/body is not claimed.
Wave in/out uses a visible change in left forearm angle, then intermediate preparation and original neutral return. Keyposes are discrete holds, not smooth/full-actor interpolation.
Notice family is a subtle blue-eye upward-left reaction with stable stance, no added symbol or motion mark.
Genuinely transparent source RGBA is preserved. Hidden RGB in alpha0 is not interpreted as a painted background.
